notes.title: Guild of Rogues Demo - Update: 0.0.2
notes.notes:
[h1]Guild of Rogues' first patch is here![/h1]

Hey!

It's been a little over a week since our demo launch, and I'm having a blast seeing your gameplay and hearing your feedback on the demo.

While we keep working on the Early Access version, the demo will be updated to fix major bugs, but for this small patch I also made some small balance changes that should make the limited experience with the demo a bit better!

Thank you so much for anyone that has given it a try!

[b][h2]Balance changes:[/h2][/b]

[Class] Mercenary: Gives 1 gold instead of 2 at the end of each combat
[Relic] Honor Medal: Now is Rare instead of Epic
[Minion] Kraken: Now is Legendary instead of Epic

[b][h2]Bug fixes:[/h2][/b]

Fixed a bug that made it impossible to choose a new Relic after restarting a run
